title: Digital Maturity Framework: edition-aware, provenance-tracked panel of digital-maturity indicators (2012-2025)
description: Code, configuration, source snapshots with per-value provenance, processed panels and result tracks of a retrieval and preprocessing pipeline for digital-maturity indicators of 12 countries over 2012-2025 (World Bank WDI, UN EGDI/OSI, WIPO GII, Oxford Insights Government AI Readiness, e-Governance Academy NCSI, UNDP education index). Version 3.1.0 adds a knowledge layer: six World Bank WDI context indicators, rolling-origin evaluation against the persistence forecast, an OWL 2 DL ontology aligned with RDF Data Cube, PROV-O, SKOS and DCAT, the populated knowledge graph with HermiT, SHACL and competency-question checks, and a Power BI project generated from the same view definitions. Third-party values remain under their publishers' terms (DATA_SOURCES.md).
notes: This work is based upon work from COST Action HiTEc, CA21163, supported by COST (European Cooperation in Science and Technology).
